title: feat: use direct ADB socket for gRPC instead of TCP port forwarding

target.summary: DummyDns.lookup returns InetAddress.getLoopbackAddress(), which causes OkHttp to replace the target socket hostname with "localhost". As a result, AdbSocketFactory attempts to connect to localabstract:localhost instead of the target webview abstract socket, silently breaking Chrome DevTools webview hierarchy inspection.
notes: faulty DummyDns implementation returning loopback address which causes OkHttp to overwrite hostname with localhost
call site configuring DummyDns on the HTTP client
